meta.description: Golden cases for the Jobify legacy HTTP contract. Load docs/api/seed.sql first and run cases in list order: several cases create or mutate rows.
meta.harness: PHP 8.4.23 built-in server + MariaDB 10.6.21, loopback-only network. See docs/api/DUDAS.md.

requestBodyTypes.multipart: multipart/form-data fields plus file paths relative to the repository root

meta.expectedHeaders: Only content-type is normative; Date, Host, Connection and X-Powered-By are environment-specific. nginx adds CORS/security headers in the real deployment.
